signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Own the home screen and core navigation, evolving it from a static, rule-based surface into an ML-orchestrated experience that surfaces the right next step for each member…
Build tight feedback loops with community members and develop a deep understanding of product issues, and how to resolve them, across every shared surface CoreUX owns
Tell the story of CoreUX’s app experience, design system, and platform work (the vision, the roadmap, and the results) to your product team, stakeholders, and the executive team
Set OKRs and stretch goals for your product and team that ladder up to company-wide priorities like wage access activation and design system adoption
Raise the bar on design quality and member experience, partnering closely with Design to uphold and evolve EarnIn’s design system across every surface
